newsitem.title: USA: Continental Information in deal with Emmes.
newsitem.headline: Continental Information in deal with Emmes.

text.p: Continental Information Systems Corp said Thursday it agreed with Emmes Investment Management Co LLC to provide high yield, short-term financing in commercial real estate deals.
The company said it will invest up to $8 million in approved transactions.
The company also said it expects to commit "additional resources" to its existing aircraft leasing business.

The company said it expects the agreement with Emmes to involve transactions that do not meet the underwriting standards of a traditional lender, and instances where they are under unusual time constraints.
Continental previously announced plans to diversify into real estate financing as an extension of its financing business.
Emmes provides high yield, short-term real estate financing.
